title: Let admins edit products
description: Adds PUT /api/products/:id for admins to change a product's name and price. Existing orders keep the totals they were placed with. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: priceCents is only checked to be a number, unlike POST /api/products: a negative price is saved, a fraction is answered as saved but stored rounded, and a value too big for the integer column makes Prisma throw, giving a 500 instead of a 400.
